notes.title: Celebrate Couch Co-Op Fest with the Chaotic Party Night bundle!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we hope you’re well? 

We’re just checking in to celebrate Steam’s Couch Co-Op Fest and the launch of a new bundle that seeks to capture the spirit of good old fashioned party game nights!  

For enjoyers of slapstick Japanese gameshows, high stakes octopus racing, and interspecies shopping trolley manoeuvring the Chaotic Party Night bundle includes Nippon Marathon, Muddledash and Supermarket Shriek plus a 15% discount when you ‘complete the set’.  

All three games will be on deep discount until 17th February so now is the perfect time to grab your friends and indulge in some truly unhinged couch co-op and PVP madness!

Nippon Marathon: A crazy, physics-driven, four-player marathon across Japan. Smash through offices and shopping malls and hurl fruit at your opponents in a party game unlike anything you've played before!

[previewyoutube=O8eyd-ooPcs;full][/previewyoutube]

Muddledash: Join your friends on a mad race to the most bopping octopus party of the year. Slap your friends down with your tentacles to wrestle the present out of their hands, and make it to the finish line first. 

[previewyoutube=gYnbkY4Fjyw;full][/previewyoutube]

Supermarket Shriek: Man meets goat in this award-winning couch-co-op adventure! Tackle outlandish courses, complete rewarding challenges and dodge deadly obstacles in a hectic race to the checkout! Packed with a frantic 38 stage campaign and 3 hilariously fun PvP party modes for up to 8 players.

[previewyoutube=POaKFrWGmI0;full][/previewyoutube]

Enjoy!

PQube and Billy Goat Entertainment

notes.title: Supermarket Shriek is OUT NOW

Men - grab your goats.

The time has come!

We can't wait to see and hear about the wholesome adventures you'll be going on alongside our unlikely duo! Feel free to tag us on Twitter via @PQubeIndies or @OfficialGoat and let us know about your experience playing the game. 

Go topple those beans! 

- PQube & BillyGoat Entertainment

notes.title: Will you find all the hidden levels in Supermarket Shriek?
notes.content:
Scattered throughout Supermarket Shriek are a number of secret levels, "cunningly" hidden amongst the shops and stores. Will you find them all? 

Complete levels and earn stars to unlock new areas. 
https://media.giphy.com/media/kfp1dLJzaZXgXeH9RD/giphy.gif
So a heroic duo of man and goat have ended up in a shopping kart together. So far so normal. As they make their way through the town, they'll need to complete the challenges that lie behind each storefront and earn stars (up to 3 are available in each store). Doing so will unlock new areas to explore!

Choose your next challenge!
https://media.giphy.com/media/AIC7drRBeGBTOHui96/giphy.gif
Each new street is packed with new, ever more outrageous challenges. "Simply" bundle your way through each doorway to see what carnage awaits inside. 

Keep a lookout for hidden entrances... 
https://media.giphy.com/media/0Sp4vWdK0345BuGWdC/giphy.gif
As you progress, keep one man-eye and one beady goat-eye out for partially obscured entrances and suspicious looking scenery!

...and discover secret levels! 
https://media.giphy.com/media/TlkayaW9R6Ng34KUl2/giphy.gif
You might just stumble across a secret level! Each has a different theme and even more stars are on offer! Over to you, completionists. 

Supermarket Shriek releases on Steam on October 23rd!

notes.title: Supermarket Shriek: How to Customise Your Characters
notes.content:
With over 50 customisation options to choose from and plenty of unlockable items,  you'll have everything you need to ensure our duo are looking at their best as they go careering onto the shop floor. Dress our heroes to impress in 4 simple steps:

Step 1 - Unlock Items
https://media.giphy.com/media/fG07MHNby8Pt8E6kOs/giphy.gif
There's a whole host of ridiculous items to unlock by completing challenges and stages in Supermarket Shriek - from snazzy specs to outrageous headgear. Every item you unlock will show up in the character settings section of the settings menu. 

Step 2- Customise Man
https://media.giphy.com/media/fik9vRTKsaYvfkUFEJ/giphy.gif
There's no doubt that our two-legged hero is a handsome chap - but nevertheless you may want to pick out a dapper shirt and tie combo to your liking. Meanwhile you can also change hair and skin colour, or equip him with some of the fetching headgear or eyewear you've picked up on your adventures.  

Step 3 - Customise Goat 
https://media.giphy.com/media/KaMPqHC8HFMISSo9lN/giphy.gif
Our four-legged hero does not wear shirts and ties (obviously - what kind of game do you think this is?!). However you can change the colour of their fur and pick out some suitable accessories. We went for the bicycle helmet above, because mammal safety is of paramount importance. 

Step 4 - The best looking duo in the aisle! 
https://media.giphy.com/media/d1bU777fNip31zFZG3/giphy.gif
Customised our duo to your liking? Then jump straight back into the action and admire your style choices before everything, and everyone, gets covered in bean juice anyway.  

Supermarket Shriek releases on Steam on 23rd October!

notes.title: 5 of our "Favourite" Obstacles in Supermarket Shriek!
notes.content:
In Supermarket Shriek, the name of the game is racing through chaotic shops and supermarkets, and getting to the checkout in the fastest time possible! But these are no ordinary shops - with each one littered with outlandish challenges and deadly obstacles. 

To give you an idea of what to expect, we've rounded up just some of the unlikely obstacles you'll find standing between you and glory!  

Sumos
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38244590/4b6994e65c13563b173f73253b462a0a97f69c15.gif
Big. Bouncy. Unmoving. 
Let's face it, you're not going to be able to shift a sumo. It will take a careful combination of man screams and goat screams to weave your way through this wall of (inflatable) warriors! 

Circular Saws!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38244590/e745189220cf193d696950ea9ee092d619a4b766.gif
We'd be hard-pushed to refer to Circular Saws as our favourites. We don't like them. 
However - they do make for an exhilarating challenge! Our advice: GET OUT THE WAY AS FAST AS YOU CAN! And watch out for spillages. 

"SIRI"
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38244590/9ecd810cb4efc1a7823ac15ec9302e4567b50e3c.gif
In Supermarket Shriek, you'll encounter large blocks and moving platforms which change direction according to which one of our two heroes is screaming. We call them "Sonic Interactive Relocation Instruments" - or "SIRI" for short. We don't see anyone having a problem with that. 
Oh, and they're also fiendishly tricky to negotiate! 

Giant Boulders. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38244590/4878f6ecaa953aeb29633a0800ac1bf6a0f6eba7.gif
An absolute classic. Film buffs should know exactly what to do when you encounter one of these (and for the rest of you, it should be pretty obvious...). Don't go thinking it will be straightforward though - Dr Jones didn't have to steer a shopping trolley...

BEANS BEANS BEANS
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38244590/fb78fd62747a73b3fbde51eefa5e6809816bc8f1.gif
In a shocking twist(!), this final obstacle is one you'll be actively trying to hit! In "Canned Carnage" you'll be tasked with toppling as many stacks of beans as you before the timer runs out. Bean juice will be spilt, things will get messy, clothes will need washing. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38244590/93daed210d807a8b425436d6364d9f5b9549538e.png

Supermarket Shriek is coming soon to Steam! Keep your eyes peeled for an exciting announcement in the coming week! 

- PQube & BillyGoat Entertainment

notes.title: #SettleTheStore with Supermarket Shriek's Multiplayer Modes
notes.content:
Supermarket Shriek careers onto Steam later this year - and when it does, you'll have plenty of madcap game modes to choose from! So let's take a closer look... 

Co-Op Gameplay in Story Mode

https://media.giphy.com/media/VIoKS9ZioMotTB22kD/giphy.gif
 
In Supermarket Shriek you can take on the 38-stage story mode solo or with a friend via local multiplayer! One player controls the screams of the man, the other the screams of the goat. You'll need to work together to guide our heroes to the checkout, avoiding the swinging axes, numerous insane obstacles and pesky DEADLY FIRE PITS along the way.
 
Control the screams using your keyboard, controller, or why not connect two headsets and *literally* shriek your way to victory? (obviously that's a rhetorical question...there is no reason not to do this).
 
Completing one story mode stage as a co-op partnership also unlocks the 3 chaotic PvP party games for between 1 & 8 players!

📝 1. "Shopping List" 📝

https://media.giphy.com/media/jrnSrnWdJbohy57Qbk/giphy.gif

A mode that will have Rylan Clark-Neal's heart all a-flutter. Just like Supermarket Sweep, "Shopping List" sees each player racing round the isles of a supermarket to be the first to collect each of the specified items. Unlike Supermarket Sweep, they'll also need to contend with moving platforms, circular saws and a pretty significant spillage in aisle 4...
 
🏁 2. "Race" 🏁

https://media.giphy.com/media/f6PG9ewS7j11ERYsrI/giphy.gif
 
Race your opponents and score points by pulling away into an unassailable lead! Sounds simple, right? But Supermarket Shriek's unique brand of (shopping) kart racing means anything is possible in this manic and unpredictable race. 

🛒 3. "Sumo" 🛒

https://media.giphy.com/media/RhZKNzJ6JN9Ia8f92e/giphy.gif

On the one hand, there's the traditional sport of Sumo. A noble form of wrestling that preserves many ancient traditions and ritual elements.
On the other hand, there's Sumo mode in Supermarket Shriek. A no-holds-barred clash of man, goat and shopping trolley on a raised platform adorned with circular saws and disappearing floors. 

Supermarket Shriek is coming soon to Steam! 
Visit the website: http://pqube.co.uk/supermarket-shriek
